Everton v Liverpool (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Hill Dickinson Stadium. The visitors have a strong recent record against their city rivals and have only lost one of their last 10 games against the Toffees. The Reds have also won the last three encounters against their hosts, including doing the double over Everton last season. This meeting last year saw Virgil van Dijk score the winner in stoppage time to give Liverpool a 2-1 win in their first visit to the Hill Dickinson Stadium.
